title: Bernhard Riemann: Selected Mathematical Papers and Collected Works (Modern LaTeX Working Drafts)
description:
Author record for Bernhard Riemann in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page groups the currently staged Riemann reader PDFs and source/provenance artifacts under a normal author-facing title.

Status at a glance.

  • Reader PDFs: [#######---] two current working readers are present: a selected-papers reader and a broader Gesammelte Werke complete-draft reader.
  • Source/artifact preservation: [##########] TeX, component PDFs, repair notes, and provenance are preserved in the artifact ZIPs.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] machine-assisted working drafts for checking, not certified critical editions.

This record replaces an accidentally public raw-source lane with a coherent author page. Raw source chunks have been moved to the original/main project record instead, where broad provenance belongs.
notes: Public author record for Riemann. Reader PDFs are top-level; TeX/source/provenance files are in ZIP artifacts.
